result.title: Memory-Augmented Online Test-Time Adaptation for EEG Motor Imagery via Perturbation Consistency and Confidence Calibration
result.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement (TIM), 2026
result.summary: Recently, electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain--computer interfaces (BCIs) have gained traction as portable neural measurement systems. However, the practical deployment of these instruments is often hindered by nonstationarity and cross-subject distribution shifts, which lead to significant intersubject inconsistency. Existing adaptation methods remain impractical for real-time measurement scenarios, as they typically require offline access to source or aggregated target data. To address these challenges, this article proposes memory-augmented online test-time adaptation (OTTA) with perturbation consistency and confidence calibration (MOPC), a source-free framework designed to enhance the reliability of BCI instrumentation. MOPC enables the measurement system to update its decoding parameters on the fly during the inference stage, facilitating single-pass adaptation without accessing sensitive source data. We introduce random-mask perturbations to enforce prediction consistency against inherent EEG signal noise and acquisition artifacts. Furthermore, a confidence-calibrated reweighting loss is designed to integrate feature-space similarity, effectively mitigating unreliable pseudolabels and class imbalance during continuous signal acquisition. To ensure system stability and prevent the catastrophic forgetting of established neural patterns, a lightweight memory module is incorporated to regularize parameter updates within a tight latency budget. Evaluated on the BCI IV IIb and OpenBMI datasets, MOPC achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming prior methods by 2.22~\% and 3.67~\%, respectively, while keeping the per-trial adaptation latency to approximately 40--60 ms. This study provides a robust, recalibration-free solution for real-time EEG decoding, marking a significant advancement in the precision and usability of practical BCI measurement instruments.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免源数据的在线测试时自适应框架 MOPC，用于 EEG 运动想象解码：以随机掩码扰动一致性约束、结合特征相似度的置信度校准重加权损失，以及轻量记忆模块正则参数更新，在单次推理过程中在线调整解码器以应对跨被试分布漂移并控制时延。
AI.relevance_reason: 领域虽远离视觉多模态，但其单次在线自适应、扰动一致性与置信度校准的伪标签筛选、记忆模块防遗忘，可能为 LVR 中推理期 latent 状态持续更新与不可靠监督加权提供可供核查的思路。
